description: What an automation did, newest first, by its id from list_automations: an ad rule's runs as the platform (or Hermoso, for Google Ads) recorded them with what changed, a boost automation's checks with the posts it boosted, an alert channel's deliveries, a comment-to-DM automation's replies. actedOnly:true keeps only the runs that changed something. Read-only, free.
